text:
ana: Pushed a small docs PR covering on-prem install appendix: HSM provider paths, minimal rewrap example, and offline registry notes. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4410
lee: Looks good. Two quick fixes: containerd key is `mirrors` (not `mirror`) and the HSM path should be templated ({{ hsm_provider_path }}).
ana: thanks, updated template and fixed containerd example. Added a tiny example rewrap script that uses the Redwood CLI shim: `redwood kms export --key old --out tmp.enc && redwood kms import --hsm --in tmp.enc --out new` (marked example-only).
lee: Nice. Can you add a note about permissions for the PKCS11 lib: `chown root:root {{ hsm_provider_path }} && chmod 440 {{ hsm_provider_path }}` and an SELinux tip?
ana: done. Also added air-gapped registry cert troubleshooting: curl with CA, `ctr images pull` debug steps, and a containerd config snippet.
infra-bot: docs-linter: 1 warning (example script missing dry-run flag).
ana: added `--dry-run` example and comment that script is not for production.
doc-bot: docs-linter: all checks passed. PR merged by ana (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/4f9a2c)
